name: Instructed Balance 22
definition: Provides information about total instructed balance.

TotalInstructedBalance.name: Total Instructed Balance
TotalInstructedBalance.definition: Provides information about the total instructed balance.

TotalAcceptedInstructionBalance.name: Total Accepted Instruction Balance
TotalAcceptedInstructionBalance.definition: Daily total of all accepted instructions for given day.  Cover protect instructions will be included in this total balance.

TotalCancelledInstructionBalance.name: Total Cancelled Instruction Balance
TotalCancelledInstructionBalance.definition: Daily total of cancelled instructions for a given day.

TotalPendingInstructionBalance.name: Total Pending Instruction Balance
TotalPendingInstructionBalance.definition: Daily total of pending instructions in pending status.  It includes cancel pending instructions.

TotalProtectInstructionBalance.name: Total Protect Instruction Balance
TotalProtectInstructionBalance.definition: Daily total of all protect instructions sent in a given day.

OptionDetails.name: Option Details
OptionDetails.definition: Provide instructed balance breakdown information per option.
